reauth_confirm.title: Renew AlorAir-Lite login
reauth_confirm.description: Connect your existing AlorAir-Lite account. The vendor API uses unencrypted HTTP: your email, session token, commands and readings are exposed in transit. Your password is RSA-wrapped for login but this does not secure the connection. Home Assistant stores the account password in its configuration; protect your configuration and backups. This unofficial integration supports devices owned by your account. Nothing is re-paired.

data.allow_insecure_http: I accept the vendor’s unencrypted HTTP connection

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: The same device identity is retained. Switching to the experimental local profile changes the available entities; existing humidity automations cannot use its power switch without adjustment. Configure routing separately before switching.

local.title: Experimental local connection
local.description: Listen for the already-provisioned appliance on your local network. You must separately route its outbound device connection to this listener; setup does not change router or Wi-Fi settings. This profile provides temperature display and experimental power control. Humidity targets, fault readings, purge and locator are not supported locally yet. It does not contact the vendor cloud. Start commands are disabled until enabled in Configure.

reconfigure_local.title: Use the experimental local connection
reconfigure_local.description: Listen for the already-provisioned appliance on your local network. You must separately route its outbound device connection to this listener; setup does not change router or Wi-Fi settings. This profile provides temperature display and experimental power control. Humidity targets, fault readings, purge and locator are not supported locally yet. It does not contact the vendor cloud. Start commands are disabled until enabled in Configure. This replaces the stored cloud credentials and retains the device identity. Restore the cloud route separately if you switch back.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Experimental actions include cloud metadata and maintenance changes. Enable them only when testing documented capabilities.

local.title: Experimental local power
local.description: Power-on uses the appliance’s existing humidity setting. Humidity mode and fault telemetry are not yet mapped locally, and local power commands still need appliance validation. Enable starts only during supervised commissioning with the unit set appropriately. Normal power-off remains available on a verified connection.
